result.Method of Attack: Multi-stage obfuscated malware that spawns detached processes to collect and exfiltrate sensitive data from crypto wallet browser extensions (Metamask, Phantom, Coinbase, etc.) including log and database files (.log, .ldb), keylogging, clipboard stealing, and downloading additional malware from ngrok endpoints
Impacted Systems: Developer machines with crypto wallet browser extensions (Chrome, Brave, Opera, Edge)
result.Attack Vector: Malicious npm package installation with preinstall hook executing obfuscated scripts that run detached processes to steal data and download further malware
Indicators of Compromise: Extension IDs: nkbihfbeogaeaoehlefnkodbefgpgknn (Metamask Chrome), ibnejdfjmmkpcnlpebklmnkoeoihofec (TronLink Chrome), ejbalbakoplchlghecdalmeeeajnimhm (MetaMask Edge), fhbohimaelbohpjbbldcngcnapndodjp (BNB Chrome), bfnaelmomeimhlpmgjnjophhpkkoljpa (Phantom Chrome), hnfanknocfeofbddgcijnmhnfnkdnaad (Coinbase Chrome), fnjhmkhhmkbjkkabndcnnogagogbneec (Ronin Chrome), aeachknmefphepccionboohckonoeemg (Coin98 Chrome), hifafgmccdpekplomjjkcfgodnhcellj (Crypto.com Chrome)
Presence of files with .log and .ldb extensions in browser extension directories
Detached process running setup-script.js for up to 40 minutes post-installation
Exfiltration of Solana id.json file if present
Unprotected keys endpoint leaking stolen credentials via GET requests
